say:1:1060900601:1.text: The test flight of the <style="highlight">joy plane</style>, a new invention by Damien. The carrying capacity has improved as well as its stability. It can drop streamers and fireworks while flying, making it perfect for celebrations!
say:1:1060900601:1.source_cn: 这次试航的<style=highlight>欢宴木翼机...

say:2:1060900602:1.text: In addition to this, the wooden plane will also carry small gifts that will be sprinkled all over the venue during the flight, bringing a little surprise to each guest!
say:2:1060900602:1.source_cn: 除此之外，木翼机也会搭载一些小礼物，在飞行的过程洒满全...

say:3:1060900603:1.text: However, as we all know, Damian's inventions aren't always perfect. This time is no exception. The joy plane was expensive to make, and it can only fly once and cannot be reused.
say:3:1060900603:1.source_cn: 不过……众所周知，达米安这孩子的发明或多或少总有一些缺...

say:4:1060900604:1.text: Therefore, we will charge a fee for each test flight. We hope you don't mind
say:4:1060900604:1.source_cn: 所以，每一架木翼机试航时，我们都会收取一些费用，希望各...

say:5:1060900605:1.text: If you are interested in the joy plane or want to invite everyone to watch the wooden plane fly, you can find me here anytime!
say:5:1060900605:1.source_cn: 如果对欢宴木翼机感兴趣，或者想邀请大家观看木翼机飞行的...
